summary: Verified the My Story typing bug fix on /studio. All 12 inputs (Bio, Location, Style, Active since, Education, Exhibitions, Awards, Influences, Website, Instagram, Twitter, plus bio textarea) now accept continuous multi-character typing without focus loss. Save Story writes to draft (toast appears), values persist after tab switch and after page reload, and Publish Changes propagates values to the public /artist/{id} page. Regressions checked: theme (theme-industrial), sections (add-section-announcement), publish header button all still work.
critical_code_review_comments: StoryEditor now correctly uses functional setState and inlined JSX; the previous inline component-per-render bug is fully resolved.

Login button uses styled anchor/button without type='submit' — minor: consider adding type='submit' + data-testid='login-submit' for easier E2E testing (workable via Enter key or text selector today).

Review request mentioned data-testid='tab-textures' — no such tab exists in current UI (textures live inside Theme & Look tab, and tex-brick still works there). Update the review checklist accordingly.
StudioEditor.js is now 1033 lines — approaching the 700-line ceiling; consider splitting into sub-modules (StoryEditor.js, PostsEditor.js, ThemeEditor.js, etc.) in a follow-up refactor.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The My Story typing bug is fully fixed. Data on Monster's artist profile has been populated + published as part of this test — main agent may want to reset via Discard if a clean state is needed. Login button on /login has no type='submit' or data-testid; use text 'SIGN IN' or add a testid.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: `const F = ({label, field, ...}) => (...)` was declared inside the StoryEditor render function, creating a NEW component reference on every render. React's reconciler treated the new `F` as a different component type each keystroke and unmounted/remounted the input, killing focus after 1 char and losing further input. Fix: JSX was inlined for every field, `patch` uses functional setState `setStory((prev) => ({...prev, [k]: v}))` to avoid stale-closure issues, and a `useEffect` on `JSON.stringify(config.artist_story)` re-syncs local state after publish/discard. Verified: 12 fields all accept full strings, save writes to draft with toast 'Story saved to draft — hit Publish to make it live', reload restores values, publish makes them visible on public /artist/{id}.
